title: hieracium bourgaei subsp. sclerophyllum
intro: Hieracium bourgaei subsp. sclerophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
